status_detail.current_operations: Company/SEC disclosures describe the Niagara Facility as energized and operating at approximately 46-50 MW; public land-use records show local SEQR/zoning process activity for continued/expanded data-center use.
status_detail.planned_expansion: Company disclosures describe a transition to more than 100 MW Tier 3 capacity and a non-binding 300 MW anchor-lease LOI; NYSRC queue materials list a separate 500 MW large-load interconnection request.
status_detail.status_basis: Existing energized load supports partial live. Expansion remains local process/interconnection queue/announced until definitive permits, construction, or interconnection milestones are independently confirmed.

contradictions.description: Sources report different capacity concepts: 46 MW currently energized/deployed, 50 MW operating in investor presentation/script, 100+ MW planned Tier 3 conversion, 300 MW non-binding anchor lease LOI, and 500 MW NYISO/NYSRC interconnection queue request.
contradictions.resolution: Record current capacity separately from planned/LOI/queue capacity; do not treat planned or queue MW as built capacity.
